title: Width bound for the canonical term
statement: Let $\phi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, and suppose its width is at most $w$. For any coordinate restriction $\rho$ under which at least one term is compatible, the canonical term selected for $\rho$ has width at most $w$.
